world.name: House of Velvet
world.ip: 5 Nights at Velvet's (original IP, Neo / Cosmic Funk Studios)
world.concept: Condemned 1980s fashion house. Undead runway models (thin, thick, BBW) still walk the catwalk after midnight. Spielberg-restraint horror: light does the storytelling.
world.up_axis: Y (GathrXR) / Z (Blender authoring, converted on GLB export with +Y up)

references: volta-makeup-room-16x9.png (overexposed vanity room vs black doorway)
atelier-lab-16x9.png (specimen tanks, dress forms, green glow, open storm sky)

zones.notes: stage, torn curtain, runway catwalk, party tables, collapsed-roof moon hole over catwalk end
two 2.6m corridors split by divider block; closet off west hall z 6..8.6
player spawn; desk, CRT monitors, 12:00 AM clock; vent exit east wall y<1
wardrobe racks, mannequins, freight gate south (barred)
LIGHT zone: overexposed vanity, mirror wall
service ramp to level 2, red indicator at top, lab gate half-open
3 specimen tanks, steel table, dress forms thin/curvy/grand, green + moonlight, open to storm sky

seraphine.look: gray-green skin, sunken cheeks, torn black chiffon + gold thread, milky eyes, perfect posture

madame_volta.look: decayed crimson velvet gown, opera gloves, beehive with moths, commanding stare

duchess_pearl.look: pearl-encrusted decaying ivory ballgown, cracked porcelain makeup, regal, slow

materials.pbr_notes: GLB-safe principled BSDF only; emissive strips for runway edges and vanity bulbs; no Blender-only shaders

budget.status: provisional (no measured GathrXR runtime budget yet)

camera_reference.hero: low angle from runway end looking toward stage, moonbeam key, red stage rim

assumptions: GathrXR importer accepts +Y-up GLB <= 200MB via public URL or manual upload
Collision handled by GathrXR per-object collidable flag; export separate _COL meshes only if runtime supports them
Primitive-built live world remains the playable version until GLB passes G4 and headset test
runtime_testing: NOT performed; required before claiming WebXR readiness
